liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Big River** (1 review): Garcia, Weir and Keith sound crisp on Big River and the Chuck Berry numbers [5]

## The recordings

- **gd78-07-01.wagner.unknown.7355.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 16 songs; 129 min; rated 3/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Described as a superb, high-quality audience recording with very clear music; Sounds weak next to Dick's Picks releases, making it hard to feel the music; At normal volume it sounds distant, like back of the room; at full volume it comes alive [3][4][5]
- **gd1978-07-01.sonyecm54p.wagner.minches.97424.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 131 min; rated 3/5 by 7 [2]

## Around the show

- The Dead were one of several acts at Willie Nelson's 4th of July event and played a single set [3]
- Field temperature was reportedly around 135 degrees, and the band had to keep retuning [7]
- The Dead were sandwiched between other bands and played only one set [7]
- A security worker reportedly said the band arrived two hours late and ran 45 minutes over [7]
- Part of Willie Nelson's annual 4th of July picnic, alongside Waylon Jennings, Jessi Colter and a local band, Missouri [8]
- Brutally hot day, with scarce water and people throwing fireworks around [8]
- Security reportedly said the band arrived two hours late and played 45 minutes beyond schedule [9]
- Heat was so intense that people were collapsing; reviewer recalls no second set, just one long one [9]
- This set has little jamming; reviewer says plentiful jams can be found on other shows [3]
- Sounds more distant than the 5-5-78 recording by comparison [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-07-01.wagner.unknown.7355.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Robert Wagner; source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Robert Wagner recorded it with Sony 54p microphones into a Sony TC-158, then transferred via MC, DA and CDR [1]
- **gd1978-07-01.sonyecm54p.wagner.minches.97424.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by David Minches; source: Master Recording: 2 Sony ECM-54 Ps >Sony 158 [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by SoundCloud: [Grateful Dead - 1978-07-01 Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City, MO](https://soundcloud.com/user-425825501/sets/grateful-dead-1978-07-01-arrowhead-stadium-kansas-city-mo) [16]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 7/1/78 Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City, MO … | Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27305894546/) [17]
